name: subscribe__max_interval_keepalive
description: Locks the matter.js-aligned heartbeat cadence: after a subscription is admitted, if no dirty marks arrive within min(MaxIntervalCeiling/2, 30 s), the engine MUST ship an empty-payload ReportData (keepalive) so Apple Home's MTRDevice / chip-tool's ReadClient does not drop the subscription. The scenario picks MaxIntervalCeiling=2 (heartbeat ≈ 1 s), waits ~1.5 s without firing any change, and asserts a keepalive arrives with attribute_reports_count=0.
